Average bill_length_mm for Adelie penguins by island (after cleaning, n=21):
- Biscoe: 38.375 mm
- Dream: 39.386 mm
- Torgersen: 39.133 mm

Problems found and fixed:
- Species label variants: " Adelie" (leading space) and "Chinstarp" (misspelling of Chinstrap) merged to allowed labels via normalize_labels (2 cells).
- 1 exact duplicate row removed via drop_duplicates.

Checks passed: bill_length_mm had no missing values, no out-of-range values (30-60 mm per rules), and no text numbers; island had no variants/missing.

Caveats: Other columns have out-of-range values not used in this question (flipper_length_mm has 3 negatives, body_mass_g has 1 extreme value 3,500,000g) but they do not affect the bill length average. Sex has 1 missing value, also not used.
